centreAddress: Highline Building, Baker's Point, Pottery Rd, Kill Of The Grange, Dún Laoghaire, A96 KW29
directions: From Dun Laoghaire Driving Test Centre on Clonkeen Crescent, pull off and take the 1st left to stay on Clonkeen Crescent.
At the end of the road, turn right onto Pottery Road and follow it for just over 1 km.
At the end of Pottery Road, turn left onto Johnstown Road.
At the next end of road, turn right onto Rochestown Avenue.
